title: string/URI decode attribution

meta.noiseRuler: none this round; the four build combinations agree to 0.28% on the suite geomean and to <=0.125 ms on every ladder rung gap

p780_L0_skeleton.notes: Loop nest and integer arithmetic only; no string is created. Floor for every other rung. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_L1_build.notes: Adds the helper call, two string index reads and three concatenations; the built string is consumed by .length only. L1 - L0 is the string-building half. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_L1f_build_flat.notes: Same as L1 but consumes the built string with charCodeAt(11), which forces a rope-backed result to flatten. L1f - L1 isolates any deferred flatten cost. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_L2_decode.notes: Adds decodeURI over the built 12-byte string, consumed by .length. L2 - L1 is the decode half in isolation. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_L2s_fromcharcode.notes: Adds String.fromCharCode(H, L) instead of decodeURI, consumed by .length. L2s - L1 is the fromCharCode half in isolation. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_L3_full.notes: The historical uri_decode_4byte source verbatim; its sourceSha256 must equal the historical case. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_L3c_full.notes: The historical uri_component_decode_4byte source verbatim. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_B0_call.notes: The helper is called twice per middle-loop trip and once per inner trip but returns a hoisted constant: isolates call plus constant-string materialization from indexing and concatenation. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_B1_index.notes: B1 - B0 is the cost of the two single-character string index reads per inner iteration. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_B2_hexconcat.notes: The full decimalToPercentHexString, consumed by .length. B2 - B1 is the two short concatenations that build "%XX". Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_B3_outerconcat.notes: Concatenates a hoisted 9-character string with a hoisted 3-character string. Isolates the 12-character result allocation from everything upstream. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_L4_decode_only.notes: Precomputes the 4096 distinct inputs and their expected results once, then runs the historical 65536 decode/fromCharCode/equality triples with zero per-iteration string building. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_L4b_arrays_only.notes: The L4 setup and loop nest with the decode/fromCharCode/equality triple replaced by the three array reads it needs. L4 - L4b is decode + fromCharCode + equality with no string building at all. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_base.notes: 65536 trips reading .length of a hoisted 12-byte string; the floor every decode control is measured against. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_plain12.notes: 12 input bytes, no percent escape, 12 output characters: scan-dominated, no escape decoding. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_ascii1.notes: 3 input bytes, one ASCII escape, 1 output character. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_ascii4.notes: 12 input bytes, four ASCII escapes, 4 narrow output characters. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_ascii16.notes: 48 input bytes, sixteen ASCII escapes, 16 narrow output characters. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_esc1.notes: 12 input bytes, one four-byte UTF-8 escape, 2 wide output units. This is the exact input shape of the historical case. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_esc2.notes: 24 input bytes, two four-byte escapes, 4 wide output units. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_esc4.notes: 48 input bytes, four four-byte escapes, 8 wide output units. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_esc8.notes: 96 input bytes, eight four-byte escapes, 16 wide output units. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_deccomp_esc1.notes: decodeURIComponent counterpart of p780_dec_esc1. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_vary_base.notes: 65536 trips reading .length of one of 64 precomputed 12-byte inputs; the floor for p780_dec_esc1_vary. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_esc1_vary.notes: 65536 decodeURI calls cycling over 64 distinct 12-byte four-byte escapes: the input shape fast path still applies but a result cache keyed on the decoded units cannot hit. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_3b1.notes: 12 input bytes and 2 wide output units, exactly like p780_dec_esc1, but a three-byte escape plus an ASCII escape, so an input shape fast path keyed on a single four-byte escape cannot apply. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_dec_esc1_13.notes: 13 input bytes: one four-byte escape plus a literal character, so a length-12 input shape fast path cannot apply. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_B2x_nonhex.notes: Identical in shape to p780_B2_hexconcat but the indexed alphabet is G..V, so a concatenation fast path keyed on the percent-hex-escape shape cannot apply. B2x - B2 is that fast path’s value. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

p780_B3f_outerconcat_flat.notes: The 9 + 3 outer concatenation consumed by charCodeAt(11) instead of .length. B3f - B3 exposes any deferred (rope) concatenation cost. Diagnostic only: not part of the 75-case compatibility geomean.

the existing URI fusion fires.measured: admission 1.000/iteration, hit 0.992/iteration, miss 0.008 (inside the empty-script floor noise)

one string-half mechanism is concentrate.measured: largest is the outer 9+3 concatenation at 21.4%; string indexing plus %XX construction is 23.0%

closureTable.unit: cycles per inner iteration, 65536 iterations, PMU counting mode, median of 8 ABBA samples, mean of two build-instance pairs

rows.stage: loop nest and integer arithmetic (present in every rung)

rows.note: could not be split further: subtracting the standalone fromCharCode rung leaves a -0.484 ms residual because the consuming statements of the three rungs overlap; this cell resolves only to the group

phase1EventCountsPerInnerIteration.method: gdb breakpoint hit counts on a reduced 256-iteration workload minus an empty-script floor; no source modification, no compiled-in counter, no change to the measured binary
phase1EventCountsPerInnerIteration.validation: every counter was first proven able to detect its event on a control where the event is known present (probe_miss) before any zero was trusted

stringIndexReads.evidence: qjs js_new_string8_len 2.098/iteration; zjs allocates none (single_byte_strings cache)

concatenations.evidence: qjs JS_ConcatStringInPlace 3.047 (1 success) plus JS_ConcatString1 2.031; zjs concatFlatStringBodiesOwned 3.047

stringEqualityCount.caveat: inferred from the source shape; not separately instrumented

uriFusionMiss.caveat: inside the empty-script floor noise (17 versus 15 absolute hits)

scopeNote: Phase 2-4 collection had already completed when the line was narrowed to close on Phase 1. The collected, validated data is retained under supportingEvidence rather than discarded; it does not change the verdict and is not part of the closure requirement.

meta.workload: reduced uri_decode_4byte, 1 repeat x 4 indexB3 x 64 indexB4 = 256 inner iterations
meta.method: gdb breakpoint hit counts, no source modification, no compiled-in counter
meta.validation: probe_hit / probe_miss are 256-call decode controls that prove each counter can detect the event before any zero is trusted

ipcTriangle.note: counting mode only; no frequency sampling; fully qualified armv8_pmuv3_1 events so no <not counted> row can appear

symbolAttribution.method: perf record -e armv8_pmuv3_1/cycles/ -c 10007 (fixed count period; 10007 is prime, the inner loop is 833 cycles on qjs and 1085 on zjs, so the period is co-prime with both), 3 records per side, symbol-scoped aggregation only
symbolAttribution.caveat: qjs JS_CallInternal is a monolith that inlines property reads and concat dispatch, so only the grouping (interpreter loop + call machinery + property/index read) is safely comparable across engines

fourByteEscapeFamily.points: p780_dec_esc2 (2 groups) / p780_dec_esc8 (8 groups); p780_dec_esc1 is deliberately excluded because the shape fast path breaks the line

controls.stage: decode, precomputed flat inputs (decode + fromCharCode + equality)
12B input, 1 four-byte escape, constant (shape hit + cache hit)
12B input, 1 four-byte escape, varying (shape hit + cache miss)
12B input, 3-byte + ASCII escape (shape miss, same 2-unit wide output)
